name: Climbing
summary: Scale walls, cliffs, buildings and other difficult surfaces safely and with reasonable speed.

name: Traps
summary: Identify, disable, bypass and create mechanical traps, alarms and concealed hazards.

name: Survival
summary: Find food, shelter and safe routes through wilderness and hostile environments.

name: Tracking
summary: Follow creatures or people by reading disturbances and signs of passage.

name: Navigation
summary: Determine direction, plan routes and avoid becoming lost.

name: Foraging
summary: Locate useful plants, food, water and natural materials.

name: Animal Handling
summary: Calm, control and understand domesticated animals or creatures used to people.

name: Perception
summary: Notice unusual sounds, movements, objects and other details that might be missed.

name: Investigation
summary: Examine locations, objects and evidence to uncover clues or hidden information.

name: Streetwise
summary: Navigate criminal circles, customs and neighbourhood politics.

name: Persuasion
summary: Convince others through reason, charm, negotiation or a credible argument.

name: Deception
summary: Mislead others through lies, omissions or carefully built stories.

name: Intimidation
summary: Influence others through threats, reputation or physical presence.

name: Insight
summary: Judge intentions, emotional state or honesty from speech and behaviour.

name: Disguise
summary: Alter your appearance, clothes and mannerisms to hide or impersonate identity.

name: Medicine
summary: Diagnose injuries, administer treatment and stabilise the severely wounded.

name: Engineering
summary: Understand, repair and modify complex machines, structures and steam equipment.

name: Gunsmithing
summary: Maintain, diagnose and repair firearms and unfamiliar weapon mechanisms.

name: Demolitions
summary: Prepare, place and safely handle explosives.

name: Forgery
summary: Create convincing false documents, signatures and seals.

name: Scholarship
summary: Recall academic knowledge concerning history, geography, politics and culture.

name: Naturalism
summary: Identify animals, plants, environments and natural phenomena.

name: Aether Lore
summary: Recognise known Aetheric phenomena, artefacts and effects.

name: Performance
summary: Entertain or captivate an audience through art, music, acting or story.

name: Crafting
summary: Create, repair and assess ordinary manufactured objects.

name: Riding
summary: Control a mount at speed and across dangerous terrain.

name: Seamanship
summary: Operate boats, sails and rigging safely.

name: Appraisal
summary: Estimate value, quality, authenticity and provenance.

name: Etiquette
summary: Understand formal behaviour, titles and social conventions.

name: Codes & Ciphers
summary: Create, recognise and decipher encoded messages and concealed communications.

name: Vehicle Handling
summary: Operate carts, carriages and powered vehicles under pressure.

name: Firearms
summary: Shoot, load and maintain rifles and pistols. Add your Agility modifier to attacks with these weapons; reloading costs 2 AP.

name: Fist Fighter
summary: Your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 + Strength damage.

name: Grifter
summary: Add your Personality modifier to rolls involving attempts to deceive or persuade someone.
